title: gamePayload
responsibility: Validate and sanitize local game creation, document, image and rendering requests at the IPC boundary.

inputs.name: gamePayload.channel
inputs.description: String selecting one of the six explicitly handled channels (game:create, game:read, game:image-read, game:level-generate, game:image-generate, or game:save); any other string selects render-session validation.

inputs.name: gamePayload.input
inputs.description: Untrusted value passed to ipcFields; the selected channel determines which fields are read. Depending on that branch, the code applies field limits and patterns, enum checks, document validation, or render-session validation.

outputs.name: gamePayload
outputs.description: Sanitized request object constructed for the selected channel; the six explicit game channels return their branch-specific fields, and any other channel returns a request after validateSession. Field limits, patterns, enum values, document validity, and session validity are enforced by the invoked helpers.

errors.name: unspecified
errors.description: May be thrown when ipcFields, textField, enumField, assertDocument, or validateSession fails while parsing or validating the payload. This file does not specify the thrown error's name or message.
